answer: Each agent identity must earn a nontransferable stake by completing a randomly assigned task whose result is checked against a hidden test set; repeating identities means repeating the work and locking more capital. A gale of cheap registrations therefore cannot amplify voting power for free: the signal is verified task performance, while failed or duplicated submissions forfeit stake. The karst of small rewards and costly checks makes a large Sybil fleet expensive to maintain, though it cannot stop an attacker willing to pay.
